title: bango panel
description: A screen described as data. A tool prints one of these; a renderer draws it.

bango.description: The document version. A renderer that meets one it does not know says so and exits.

id.description: Identifies the screen, so a renderer can remember cursor, filter and folds per panel.

empty.description: What to say when there are no rows.

order.description: Section ids, as a preference. Unnamed sections follow; a name that is not present is ignored.

sections.description: A panel may have no sections at all: that is an empty state, and `empty` is what it renders.

actions.description: Named actions the rows refer to.

oneLine.description: A value is one line: no tab, carriage return or newline.

layout.description: How the rows are placed. Columns is the default and aligns them; lines writes each row's one field out as it was given.

id.description: Stable, and unique across the whole panel including children.

actions.description: Names of the actions legal on this row.

children.description: At most 8 deep, which this schema cannot express.

tone.description: What the whole row is, when that is worth saying.

target.description: The id an action uses instead of this row's own.

name.description: Unique within a row. Columns are the union of these, in first-seen order.

spans.description: Stretches of the value the producer has already decided something about, in runes, in order and not overlapping.

kind.description: Semantic, not presentational. A renderer decides truncation and alignment from it.

mark.description: A state name, never a character. The renderer owns the glyph.

key.description: Unambiguous for a row, not across the panel. Renderer keys are reserved.

verb.description: The command, in drive mode only. Never executed in select mode.

args.description: {row}, {input} and {choice} are substituted as whole argv elements. There is no shell.

input.description: Prompt for one line; it becomes {input}.

choices.description: Offer a list; the pick becomes {choice}.

panel.description: This action's command prints another panel; render it instead of refreshing.

global.description: Applies to the screen, not a row.

retry.description: Offered on r when a refusal contains `when`.

when.description: Matched against the refusal. Empty matches anything.
